pages.text: $(#FFD700)🌟 Divine Forging · Reign Over All 🏰$()$(br2)$(l)$(#D4AF37)「A forbidden drink from the banquet of gods, where mere mortals sip and tremble before divine power」$()$(br)When the eternal sigils of the $(#FF8C00)Enchanted Golden Apple$(), the divinity of the $(#D4AF37)Sacred Gold Bricks$(), the purity of the $(#5F9EA0)Millennium Snow Lotus$(), and the blazing essence of $(#DAA520)Pure Primal Honey$() merge within the $(#483D8B)Holy Light Teapot$()—this is the pinnacle of $(l)defensive magic in the material world$().

$(#9370DB)▌ Five Divine Blessings $()$(br2)$(l)$(#8B0000)🛡 Holy Light Barrier$()$(br)Ethereal $(#D4AF37)angelic wings$() form a protective shield.$(br2)$(l)$(#FF69B4)💫 Tide of Life$()$(br)Wounds regenerate $(#FF1493)at a visible rate$().$(br2)$(l)$(#FF4500)🔥 Immunity to Dragonfire$()$(br)Skin is covered in $(#CD5C5C)dragon-scale$() magic runes.$(br2)$(l)$(#4169E1)👁 Eagle Vision$()$(br)Pupils shift into $(#000080)owl$() night vision mode.$(br2)$(l)$(#32CD32)🍃 Nature’s Sanctuary$()$(br)All damage triggers $(#98FB98)emerald light waves$() that reduce harm.

$(br2)$(#4B0082)▌ Divine Forging Process $()$(br)- Use a $(#9370DB)Star Silver Dagger$() to carve $(#FF8C00)golden apple sigils$() onto its $(#FFD700)surface$(), allowing better fusion into the brew.$(br)- Dry the $(#5F9EA0)snow lotus$() under $(#00BFFF)moonlight$() for $(#DAA520)seven days and nights$().$(br)- $(#D4AF37)Gold blocks$() must be $(#FF0000)smelted in dragon’s breath$() to become $(#D4AF37)liquid divine gold$().$(br)- Infuse the blend within a $(#483D8B)pentagram$() alongside $(#32CD32)Life’s Spring Essence$().$(br2)$(#8A2BE2)※$() A perfect brew forms a $(#FFD700)winged angel$() relief upon the surface.

$(br2)$(#2F4F4F)『 The Sacred Tome of Heaven 』$()$(br)Records from the Six-Winged Angel's Feathered Scroll:$(br)'This elixir contains:$(br)- $(#FF8C00)Michael$()’s flame resistance blessing$(br)- $(#4169E1)Gabriel$()’s night vision sight$(br)- $(#32CD32)Raphael$()’s healing radiance$(br)- $(#9370DB)Uriel$()’s absolute defense$(br)- $(#D4AF37)Metatron$()’s divine order protection$(br)Those whose hearts are not pure shall suffer $(#FF0000)divine backlash every three hours$(),$(br)for to touch the realm of gods is to bear $(#8B0000)the consequence of hubris$().'
